unexpected_failures.diagnosis: Output-field negative selected a beat with a preceding held-valid obligation; held_output correctly fired before the intended field detector. Select unheld transfers for field probes. Retirement expectations also use contract length rather than observed last, preventing a corrupt last from defining the expected completion.

Detector-removal qualification exposed redundant ID checks after an absent expected completion. Gate ID comparisons on an expected event so removal is assessed by the intended presence self-test, without a secondary alarm.
Preparation config generator omitted dependent scalar width parameters required by public tm_types.svh. Generate guarded index/count/deficit widths from selected public profile before compilation.
Replay bench used logical negation of 32-bit fscanf integers, rejected by fatal Verilator width warnings. Use explicit zero comparisons; no warning suppression.

Expected planted response fault fired the correct SV response detector; the new handler incorrectly required normal completion before checking the exported failing prefix. Require the exact intended first diagnostic and independently replay the sampled prefix. Captured handler failures remain retained; these are not RTL defects.

New missing-info detector-removal fixture used a one-beat atomic commit; removing presence also exposed commit completeness. Move the isolated presence-removal probe to a legal multibeat reservation edge without a same-edge commit, retaining the separate atomic legal baseline. The model detector correctly rejects missing info. No RTL was executed.

Managed-environment reconnect lost the process-session handle. Child compilations/checks completed PASS; the parent was later observed defunct and only two of 24 orchestration records existed. Parent exit status/root cause unavailable. Resume from retained passing summaries using file-backed parent output; no test result is reclassified.

Link-capture bookkeeping used (descriptor ID, cell ID), so a second packet reusing both IDs could inherit the prior packet capture. Actual replay accepted missing link queries in the second lifetime. Expectations already identify packets by reservation ordinal; key capture by that ordinal and add a two-lifetime regression. No RTL was executed.

Actual F0 baseline UVM output exercised only source/queue zero. Required metadata coverage lacked source/queue observed bins. Vary legal descriptor metadata across all profile source/queue values and require bins from sampled output; include maximum descriptor ID. Preserve allocator/scheduler abstraction: this is a memory/TX component fixture, not pool-policy qualification.
